== Notes ==
* Damage is dealt directly after a spell is cast, but before the spell's effect takes place. For example, if an assassin uses [[Death's Charge]] on an elementalist enchanted with Sliver Armor, the assassin will take damage from Sliver Armor before being healed by Death's Charge.

== Trivia ==
* Players commonly misspell this skill as "S'''il'''ver Armor."
* Before the [[Feedback:Game updates/20100521| May 21st, 2010 update]], Sliver Armor sometimes targeted one particular foe instead of different random foes.
